en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a staged opera or theatre scene in an ornate 18th‑century interior. A woman in a long dress stands near the center while a man in a military-style uniform kneels before her, reaching out. The backdrop features tall doors and decorative moldings. Handwritten Cyrillic text appears across the bottom identifying the work and performers.
